svg.title: jenkins-bench: supply-chain audit for Jenkins
svg.desc: Report rows from jenkins-bench scanning its bundled sample controller: CIS-2.1.6 FAIL, an anonymous GET of the API returned 200; CIS-2.2.3 FAIL, 2 executors on the built-in node; CIS-2.1.2 FAIL, a pipeline runs outside the Groovy sandbox; CIS-2.1.5 PASS, CSRF protection is enabled; CIS-2.3.5 MANUAL, the job configuration needs Job/ExtendedRead. 15 controls from CIS section 2, GET requests only, and a control it cannot see reports MANUAL rather than PASS.
